# momo9113-coder portfolio evidence index

Purpose: evidence-grounded CV, statement, and interview drafting. This is a machine entry point, not a claim that every public repository is original portfolio work.

READ FIRST
1. Project routes and verification protocol: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/momo9113-coder/portfolio-evidence-index/main/portfolio.json
2. Complete public repository inventory: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/momo9113-coder/portfolio-evidence-index/main/generated/github-repositories.json
3. Live GitHub owner API: https://api.github.com/users/momo9113-coder/repos?per_page=100&type=owner&sort=updated

INTERPRETATION
- `project_routes` points to the three resume-eligible, authored projects and tells you what to inspect.
- The complete inventory also contains forks and must not be treated as proof of authorship.
- ROGII/Kaggle is included even though it is maintained in a separate engineering workflow.
- Discover the current public commit first, then read the routed source files and independently evaluate the code, tests, reports, releases, CI, and deployment.
- Do not copy a metric from this index: extract it from project evidence, retain its date and evaluation scope, and pin the final claim to a commit.
- Re-check time-sensitive deployment, Actions, release, and Kaggle leaderboard state before submission.
- Do not infer causality, production impact, users, revenue, novelty, team size, or final competition standing.

CURRENT RESUME-ELIGIBLE PROJECTS
- rogii-wellbore-geology-portfolio: engineering ML / Kaggle competition
- loadlens-forecasting-service: time-series ML service and public app
- commercelens-analytics-warehouse: SQL/DuckDB analytics engineering and public report

EXCLUDED BY DEFAULT
- hajiren: public fork; do not present it as original work or a primary portfolio project.

PERSONAL DATA
This repository intentionally omits the candidate's legal name, contact details, institution name, and unpublished manuscript content. Obtain those separately and preserve placeholders until explicitly supplied.
